sentences.en: In the evening I cook a simple meal.

sentences.ar: אני מכניס הכול לסיר עם מים.
sentences.en: I put everything into a pot with water.
In the kitchen there's a very good smell.
After half an hour the food is ready.
I eat alone and listen to music.
